reason: Startup now owns mention_decor and prev_decor=STAIRS, but object-free movement still skips pickup(1), describe_decor supports only the startup staircase, and check_here/look_here still reject every mention_decor pile. boundary.startingEvent: After the source-faithful startup staircase description has stored STAIRS, a sighted ordinary hero with mention_decor and no autopickup makes an object-free step onto ordinary ROOM or CORR, then a same-terrain one-square step onto a two-to-four-object pile.
boundary.endingEvent: The Things-that-are-here window is dismissed and the game reaches the next command boundary with the ordinary terrain retained in iflags.prev_decor.
boundary.validInputs: Ordinary one-square ROOM-to-ROOM or CORR-to-CORR walks following a silent non-feature transition that establishes the terrain memory; mention_decor; no autopickup; pile_limit 5; two to four non-boulder, source-nameable objects; sighted, unimpeded hero.
boundary.observables: Hero position and turn/run state, prev_decor transitions from STAIRS to ordinary terrain and remains there, exact PRNG calls, complete cells/attributes/cursors, input waits and menu restoration, object-chain identity/knowledge, and persisted state through the next prompt.
boundary.exclusions: Furniture, doors and doorways, stairs after startup, unequal feature-bearing terrain, ice/pools/lava, traps, engravings, regions, shops, hallucination, blindness, reqmenu, pile-limit count output, multibyte names, and every describe_decor branch that speaks, defers, suppresses a dungeon feature, or reports returning to ground.

sourceReview: The implementation follows pickup.c describe_decor(), pickup() and check_here() in source order. A fresh seed 6231371 ROOM route from canonical startup crossed four object-free squares, opened and dismissed a same-terrain three-object window, and matched 2,135 PRNG calls plus nine complete screens and cursors. CORR has direct source-boundary coverage because this slice does not broaden the doorway transitions needed to seek a live corridor route. Excluded speaking, stateful, count, shop, multibyte-name, reqmenu and exceptional branches remain fail-closed. Final readiness and commitChecked belong to the orchestrator.
